body.en: Read the `busa-linkedin-desk` skill in this folder and follow its workflow, then register the person I describe as a contact: name, role, company, and their LinkedIn profile URL. Identity is the profile URL — if it matches an existing contact, update that row instead of creating a new one.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹的 `busa-linkedin-desk` skill 并遵循其工作流程，然后把我描述的人登记为联系人：姓名、职务、公司和 LinkedIn 主页 URL。对人靠主页 URL——如果与已有联系人相同，更新那条记录，不要新建。

label.en: Register a contact by profile URL
label.zh-CN: 按主页 URL 登记联系人

body.en: Read the `busa-linkedin-desk` skill in this folder, then show me the full conversation history with the contact I name: every message in order, the replies I approved, and any open actions. Do not change anything.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹的 `busa-linkedin-desk` skill，然后给我看我点名的联系人的全部沟通记录：按顺序的每条消息、我批过的回复、以及未完成的处理事项。不要修改任何内容。

label.en: Show a contact's full conversation history
label.zh-CN: 看一个联系人的全部沟通记录

body.en: Read the `busa-linkedin-desk` skill in this folder, then list the contacts still marked unverified, with the message that matched them, so I can confirm or reject each match. Do not change anything.
body.zh-CN: 先阅读本文件夹的 `busa-linkedin-desk` skill，然后列出仍标为未核验的联系人，连同匹配到他们的消息，让我逐个确认或排除。不要修改任何内容。

label.en: List unverified contacts for me to confirm
label.zh-CN: 列出待我确认的未核验联系人

description: People the desk talks to — identity is the LinkedIn profile URL, never the name alone. Unmatched senders land here as unverified candidates until a human confirms them. / 外联台沟通的对象——身份认 LinkedIn 主页 URL，绝不只认姓名。未匹配上的发信人先落为未核验候选，等人确认。
name: Contacts / 联系人

views.description: Contacts matched from conversations that a human has not confirmed yet / 从对话匹配来的联系人，人还没有确认过
